actions.reason: RegexTokenizer.train: when a chunk is merged, update pair counts and the where-index only for pairs touching merged occurrences (the left/right neighbours, handling adjacent/overlapping occurrences like basic._update_stats, weighted by chunk multiplicity), instead of subtracting every old pair and re-adding every new pair (plus redundant where[p].add) of the chunk. Final counts and the set of zero-deleted pairs are identical; dict order only matters for a unique max, so the chosen merges are unchanged. Measured train_ir ratio 0.9586, equivalence identical.
